title: Man Gets Caught Trying To Destroy Dr*gs in The Back of Cop Car
description:
This man made this case even more interesting when he ate crack right in front of an officer. Both of them were quite shocked to find themselves arrested after committing a crime. Clearly, it was the cops' fault for doing their job correctly. The man was in disbelief. How could they do this to him? All he was trying to do was commit silly little felonies—it was his thing. He was deeply touched by the officer's actions. Watch how the officer is swayed by the man's beautiful eyes. While taking him to the criminal meetup and beat-up department (jail), the officer noticed him feasting on crack. The man was a tough nut to crack. He was charged with possession of controlled substances and resisting arrest while the female was charged with resisting arrest.
